description:
## Finding
\`pkix-chain/Cargo.toml:24\`: \`[dev-dependencies]\` section is empty.
\`pkix-chain-simple/Cargo.toml:23\`: same.

## Why P4
Cosmetic. Empty section is harmless but suggests dev-deps were once planned and not added, or the test suites don't need anything beyond runtime deps.

## Fix
Delete the empty section header.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-chain/Cargo.toml:24\`, \`pkix-chain-simple/Cargo.toml:23\`.
title: P4: empty [dev-dependencies] sections in pkix-chain and pkix-chain-simple Cargo.toml
